answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ocean, expire in grove, and zephyr lists each expiry. Anyone running 22 aliases as a result needs 149 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1620 identities would post 2572 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
